summary.en: Standard first-time, in-person application for an adult requesting their own clearance.
summary.fil: Karaniwang unang aplikasyon na may personal na pagpunta para sa nasa hustong gulang na kumukuha ng sariling clearance.

location.en: Choose a participating police station and schedule in the NPCS portal (such as Batangas City, Lipa, Taal, or San Pablo stations).
location.fil: Pumili ng kalahok na police station at iskedyul sa NPCS portal (tulad ng istasyon sa Batangas City, Lipa, Taal, o San Pablo).

fee.en: ~₱150 + e-payment fee; free once for First-Time Jobseekers (RA 11261)
fee.fil: ~₱150 + bayad sa e-payment; libre nang isang beses sa First-Time Jobseeker (RA 11261)

processingTime.en: Same day (~30–60 mins at station) if no HIT
processingTime.fil: Parehong araw (~30–60 minuto sa istasyon) kung walang HIT

notice.en: Source checked. Confirm accepted ID and current station slots in the portal. Renewals and fee exemptions follow separate portal options.
notice.fil: Nasuri ang sanggunian. Kumpirmahin sa portal ang tinatanggap na ID at iskedyul ng istasyon. May hiwalay na opsyon para sa renewal at exemption sa bayad.

acceptedIds.en: PhilSys / National ID (or ePhilID)
acceptedIds.fil: PhilSys / National ID (o ePhilID)

acceptedIds.en: Philippine Passport
acceptedIds.fil: Pasaporte ng Pilipinas

acceptedIds.en: LTO Driver's License
acceptedIds.fil: Lisensya sa Pagmamaneho (LTO)

acceptedIds.en: UMID, PRC ID, or Postal ID
acceptedIds.fil: UMID, PRC ID, o Postal ID

acceptedIds.en: Voter's ID / Voter's Certification with photo, Senior Citizen, or PWD ID
acceptedIds.fil: Voter's ID / Voter's Certification na may larawan, Senior Citizen, o PWD ID

tips.en: First-Time Jobseekers (RA 11261) can avail of a free clearance once—prepare a Barangay Certificate & Oath of Undertaking before booking.
tips.fil: May isang beses na libreng clearance ang First-Time Jobseekers (RA 11261)—ihanda ang Barangay Certificate at Oath of Undertaking bago mag-book.

tips.en: Save an offline screenshot of both your payment confirmation and NPC appointment reference number in case signal is weak inside the station.
tips.fil: Mag-save ng offline screenshot ng kumpirmasyon ng bayad at reference number ng NPC appointment kung sakaling mahina ang signal sa istasyon.

tips.en: Arrive 15–30 minutes early in neat, collared or smart-casual attire for photo capture.
tips.fil: Dumating nang 15–30 minutong mas maaga at magsuot ng maayos na damit para sa pagkuha ng larawan.

detail.en: Register on the NPCS portal with an active email and complete your personal profile.
detail.fil: Magrehistro sa NPCS portal gamit ang aktibong email at kumpletuhin ang iyong profile.

detail.en: Start a clearance application; select your purpose, participating police station, and date. Keep the reference number.
detail.fil: Simulan ang aplikasyon; piliin ang layunin, istasyon ng pulisya, at petsa. Itabi ang reference number.

detail.en: Pay via the portal's accredited e-payment options (or select the RA 11261 First-Time Jobseeker option if eligible) and keep the confirmation.
detail.fil: Magbayad gamit ang mga opsyon sa portal (o piliin ang First-Time Jobseeker kung kwalipikado) at itabi ang kumpirmasyon.

detail.en: Bring your original valid ID, payment confirmation, and reference number. Complete photo, fingerprints, and signature capture; follow release instructions.
detail.fil: Dalhin ang orihinal na ID, kumpirmasyon ng bayad, at reference number. Magpakuha ng larawan, fingerprint, at lagda; sundin ang tagubilin sa pagkuha.

text.en: One original valid government-issued ID accepted by PNP
text.fil: Isang orihinal at balidong government-issued ID na tinatanggap ng PNP
Katibayan o kumpirmasyon ng bayad
Reference number ng NPC appointment

text.en: Black pen and printed/screenshot copy of appointment details
text.fil: Itim na bolpen at naka-print o screenshot na detalye ng appointment

summary.en: Standard first-time, in-person application for an adult requesting their own clearance.
summary.fil: Karaniwang unang aplikasyon na may personal na pagpunta para sa nasa hustong gulang na kumukuha ng sariling clearance.

location.en: Choose an NBI branch and schedule in the official portal (e.g., Batangas City, Lipa, or Calamba branches).
location.fil: Pumili ng sangay ng NBI at iskedyul sa opisyal na portal (hal., Batangas City, Lipa, o Calamba).

fee.en: ~₱130 + e-payment fee; free once via First-Time Jobseeker tab (RA 11261)
fee.fil: ~₱130 + bayad sa e-payment; libre nang isang beses sa First-Time Jobseeker tab (RA 11261)

processingTime.en: Same day if no HIT; ~5–10 working days if WITH HIT verification
processingTime.fil: Parehong araw kung walang HIT; ~5–10 araw ng trabaho kung may HIT

notice.en: Source checked. Confirm accepted IDs and current instructions with NBI. Renewals and First-Time Jobseeker claims use dedicated portal flows.
notice.fil: Nasuri ang sanggunian. Kumpirmahin sa NBI ang tinatanggap na ID at tagubilin. May hiwalay na daloy para sa renewal at First-Time Jobseeker.

acceptedIds.en: PhilSys / National ID (or ePhilID)
acceptedIds.fil: PhilSys / National ID (o ePhilID)

acceptedIds.en: Philippine Passport
acceptedIds.fil: Pasaporte ng Pilipinas

acceptedIds.en: LTO Driver's License, UMID, PRC ID, or Postal ID
acceptedIds.fil: Lisensya sa Pagmamaneho (LTO), UMID, PRC ID, o Postal ID

acceptedIds.en: PSA Birth Certificate (commonly accepted as one of two supporting IDs)
acceptedIds.fil: PSA Birth Certificate (madalas tinatanggap bilang isa sa dalawang ID)

acceptedIds.en: School ID with current registration form (for students)
acceptedIds.fil: School ID na may kasalukuyang registration form (para sa mga mag-aaral)

tips.en: Getting a "HIT" simply means your name matches another record in the database—it is not a criminal record. Expect a return date after quality verification.
tips.fil: Ang "HIT" ay nangangahulugang may kapangalan ka lamang sa sistema—hindi ito nangangahulugang may kaso ka. Babalik ka lamang sa nakatakdang petsa.

tips.en: First-Time Jobseekers must apply through the dedicated FIRST TIME JOBSEEKERS option in the NBI portal and bring their Barangay Certificate + Oath.
tips.fil: Dapat gamitin ng First-Time Jobseekers ang nakalaang FIRST TIME JOBSEEKERS na opsyon sa NBI portal at dalhin ang Barangay Certificate + Oath.

tips.en: Double-check the spelling of your full name, middle name, and birthdate before paying—errors cannot be edited after payment.
tips.fil: Suriing mabuti ang baybay ng buong pangalan at petsa ng kapanganakan bago magbayad—hindi na ito mababago pagkatapos magbayad.

detail.en: Create an account on the official NBI portal. Verify your personal details match your valid IDs and birth certificate.
detail.fil: Gumawa ng account sa opisyal na NBI portal. Tiyaking tugma ang detalye sa iyong mga ID at birth certificate.

detail.en: Choose the valid IDs you will bring, select your NBI branch and appointment slot, and save your reference number.
detail.fil: Piliin ang mga dadalhing ID, sangay ng NBI at iskedyul ng appointment, at itabi ang reference number.

detail.en: Pay through the displayed payment channels (or submit First-Time Jobseeker details), save proof, and check payment status.
detail.fil: Magbayad gamit ang ipinapakitang paraan, itabi ang katibayan, at tingnan kung PAID na ang status.

detail.en: Present your reference number, payment proof, and two valid IDs. Complete biometrics and data review, then follow releasing or HIT return instructions.
detail.fil: Ipakita ang reference number, katibayan ng bayad, at dalawang ID. Kumpletuhin ang biometrics at sundin ang tagubilin sa pagkuha o pagbabalik.

text.en: Two original, valid government-issued IDs accepted by NBI
text.fil: Dalawang orihinal at balidong government-issued ID na tinatanggap ng NBI

text.en: Application reference number or QR code
text.fil: Reference number o QR code ng aplikasyon
Katibayan ng bayad o resibo

text.en: Barangay First-Time Jobseeker Certificate & Oath (only if availing RA 11261 free fee)
text.fil: Barangay First-Time Jobseeker Certificate at Oath (kung kukuha ng libreng bayad sa RA 11261)

summary.en: Official security-paper (SECPA) birth certificate copy requested for school, passport, SSS, or employment.
summary.fil: Opisyal na kopya ng birth certificate sa security paper (SECPA) para sa paaralan, pasaporte, SSS, o trabaho.

location.en: PSA Civil Registry System (CRS) Outlet (e.g., Fiesta World Mall, Lipa City by online appointment) or official online delivery.
location.fil: PSA CRS Outlet (hal., Fiesta World Mall, Lipa City sa pamamagitan ng online appointment) o opisyal na online delivery.

fee.en: ~₱155 per copy at CRS outlet; ~₱365 per copy for online delivery
fee.fil: ~₱155 bawat kopya sa CRS outlet; ~₱365 bawat kopya sa online delivery

processingTime.en: Same day at CRS outlet with appointment; ~3–8 working days via courier
processingTime.fil: Parehong araw sa CRS outlet kung may appointment; ~3–8 araw ng trabaho sa delivery

validity.en: No expiration (Permanent Validity Act, RA 11909) while intact and readable
validity.fil: Walang expiration (RA 11909) hangga't malinaw at hindi sira

notice.en: Distinct from a Local Civil Registry (LCR) copy. Confirm whether the requesting office requires PSA SECPA paper.
notice.fil: Iba ito sa kopya mula sa Local Civil Registry (LCR). Tiyakin kung PSA SECPA ang hinihingi ng tanggapan.

acceptedIds.en: PhilSys / National ID (or ePhilID)
acceptedIds.fil: PhilSys / National ID (o ePhilID)

acceptedIds.en: Philippine Passport, Driver's License, UMID, PRC ID, or Postal ID
acceptedIds.fil: Pasaporte ng Pilipinas, Driver's License, UMID, PRC ID, o Postal ID

acceptedIds.en: School ID with current registration/enrollment proof (for students requesting own record)
acceptedIds.fil: School ID na may patunay ng kasalukuyang pagpapatala (para sa estudyante)

tips.en: Under RA 11909, PSA Birth Certificates no longer expire—you do not need a newly dated copy unless an older copy is torn, blurred, or specifically needs updating.
tips.fil: Sa ilalim ng RA 11909, hindi na nag-e-expire ang PSA Birth Certificate—hindi kailangang kumuha ng bago kung malinaw at buo pa ang luma.

tips.en: For CRS outlet walk-in, book a slot at appointment.psa.gov.ph first; outlets generally require an appointment.
tips.fil: Para sa pagpunta sa CRS outlet, mag-book muna ng iskedyul sa appointment.psa.gov.ph.

tips.en: If your birth was recently registered or corrected at your municipality, confirm it has been endorsed to PSA before ordering.
tips.fil: Kung bagong rehistro o may pagwawasto sa munisipyo, tiyakin munang naipasa na ito sa PSA bago umorder.

title.en: Choose outlet pickup or online delivery
title.fil: Pumili ng CRS outlet o online delivery

detail.en: Decide whether to visit a PSA CRS outlet (lower fee, same-day release) or order online for door-to-door courier delivery.
detail.fil: Magpasya kung pupunta sa PSA CRS outlet (mas mura, parehong araw) o oorder online para sa delivery.

title.fil: Mag-book ng appointment o magsumite ng request

detail.en: Enter full birth details (name at birth, date/place of birth, parents' names) and save your appointment slip or reference number.
detail.fil: Ilagay ang kumpletong detalye ng kapanganakan at itabi ang appointment slip o reference number.

place.fil: Opisyal na PSA booking / order site

detail.en: Pay at the CRS outlet cashier on your appointment date or via accredited online/over-the-counter channels for delivery.
detail.fil: Magbayad sa cashier ng CRS outlet sa araw ng appointment o sa accredited na bayaran kung online delivery.

place.en: PSA CRS cashier or accredited payment channel
place.fil: Cashier ng PSA CRS o accredited payment channel

title.en: Claim or receive your SECPA copy
title.fil: Kunin o tanggapin ang kopyang SECPA

detail.en: Present your valid ID and receipt/reference at the releasing window (or to the courier upon delivery) and inspect all printed details.
detail.fil: Ipakita ang iyong valid ID at resibo sa releasing window (o sa courier) at suriin ang nakaimprentang detalye.

place.en: PSA CRS Outlet or delivery address
place.fil: PSA CRS Outlet o address ng paghahatid

text.en: One valid government-issued ID (or Student ID with enrollment proof)
text.fil: Isang balidong government-issued ID (o Student ID na may patunay ng pagpapatala)

text.en: Complete birth details (exact name, date/place of birth, parents' full names)
text.fil: Kumpletong detalye ng kapanganakan (buong pangalan, petsa/lugar, pangalan ng mga magulang)

text.en: Confirmed CRS appointment slip or online order reference number
text.fil: Kumpirmadong CRS appointment slip o reference number ng online order

text.en: Exact cash for CRS cashier or online payment receipt
text.fil: Eksaktong bayad para sa cashier o resibo ng online payment

title.fil: Lokal na Kopya ng Tala ng Kapanganakan (Taal LCR)

summary.en: For your own existing birth record registered in Taal. A local certified copy is different from a PSA SECPA certificate.
summary.fil: Para sa sarili mong umiiral na tala ng kapanganakan na nakarehistro sa Taal. Iba ang lokal na kopya sa sertipikong SECPA mula sa PSA.

location.en: Taal, Batangas. Confirm the current Municipal Local Civil Registrar office counter and hours before travelling.
location.fil: Taal, Batangas. Kumpirmahin muna sa Municipal Local Civil Registrar ang kasalukuyang tanggapan at oras bago bumiyahe.

fee.en: Confirm current municipal copy fee directly with Taal LCR
fee.fil: Kumpirmahin sa Taal LCR ang kasalukuyang bayad sa lokal na kopya

processingTime.en: Confirm current releasing schedule with Taal LCR
processingTime.fil: Kumpirmahin sa Taal LCR ang kasalukuyang tagal ng paglabas

validity.en: Local certified true copy (distinct from PSA SECPA)
validity.fil: Lokal na certified true copy (iba sa PSA SECPA)

notice.en: Current procedure not yet confirmed. The available online charter is older (2019). Contact the Taal Municipal Local Civil Registrar for updated requirements, fees, and office directions before visiting.
notice.fil: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang kasalukuyang proseso. Luma (2019) ang makukuhang charter online. Makipag-ugnayan muna sa Taal Municipal Local Civil Registrar para sa updated na kailangan, bayad, at direksyon.

tips.en: Most schools, employers, and DFA Passport require a PSA Birth Certificate (SECPA), not a Local Civil Registry copy—check which one you need first.
tips.fil: Karaniwang PSA Birth Certificate (SECPA) ang hinihingi ng paaralan, trabaho, at pasaporte—tiyakin muna kung lokal na kopya talaga ang kailangan.

tips.en: Local LCR copies are usually needed when your PSA copy is unreadable, missing/unendorsed, or undergoing record correction.
tips.fil: Karaniwang kinukuha ang lokal na kopya kung malabo ang PSA copy, wala pa sa PSA, o may proseso ng pagwawasto ng tala.

summary.en: First-time Philippine passport application for an adult (18+) with an existing PSA Birth Certificate.
summary.fil: Unang pagkuha ng pasaporte ng Pilipinas para sa nasa hustong gulang (18+) na may PSA Birth Certificate.

location.en: Book a DFA Consular Office on passport.gov.ph (e.g., 2F Robinsons Place Lipa or SM City San Pablo).
location.fil: Pumili ng DFA Consular Office sa passport.gov.ph (hal., 2F Robinsons Place Lipa o SM City San Pablo).

fee.fil: ₱950 Regular / ₱1,200 Expedited (+ opsyonal na bayad sa courier)

notice.en: Source checked. Confirm accepted IDs and specific consular office instructions on the DFA portal before booking.
notice.fil: Nasuri ang sanggunian. Kumpirmahin sa DFA portal ang tinatanggap na ID at tagubilin ng consular office bago mag-book.

acceptedIds.en: PhilSys / National ID (or ePhilID)
acceptedIds.fil: PhilSys / National ID (o ePhilID)

acceptedIds.en: UMID, LTO Driver's License, or PRC ID
acceptedIds.fil: UMID, LTO Driver's License, o PRC ID

acceptedIds.en: Digitized Postal ID (issued 2016 onwards)
acceptedIds.fil: Digitized Postal ID (inilabas mula 2016)

acceptedIds.en: Old Voter's ID or COMELEC Voter's Certificate issued from Intramuros
acceptedIds.fil: Voter's ID o COMELEC Voter's Certificate mula sa Intramuros

acceptedIds.en: School ID with current Certificate of Registration (for college students)
acceptedIds.fil: School ID na may kasalukuyang Certificate of Registration (para sa mga estudyante)

tips.en: Bring both the ORIGINAL and clear photocopies of your PSA Birth Certificate and valid ID—DFA keeps the photocopies.
tips.fil: Dalhin ang ORIHINAL at malinaw na photocopy ng PSA Birth Certificate at valid ID—kinukuha ng DFA ang mga photocopy.

tips.en: Wear a collared shirt and avoid earrings, facial piercings, or colored contact lenses for the biometric photo.
tips.fil: Magsuot ng damit na may kuwelyo at huwag magsuot ng hikaw o colored contact lens para sa larawan.

tips.en: Carefully check every letter of your name and birthplace on the encoder's monitor before confirming.
tips.fil: Suriing mabuti ang bawat letra ng pangalan at lugar ng kapanganakan sa monitor bago kumpirmahin.

detail.en: Visit passport.gov.ph, select Individual Appointment, pick your Consular Office and slot, and enter your details accurately.
detail.fil: Pumunta sa passport.gov.ph, piliin ang Individual Appointment, ang Consular Office at petsa, at ilagay ang tamang detalye.

detail.en: Pay the processing fee using the generated payment reference at accredited partners or e-wallets before the reservation expires.
detail.fil: Bayaran ang processing fee gamit ang reference number sa accredited payment centers o e-wallet bago mag-expire.

detail.en: Download and print the confirmed application form and e-receipt sent to your email, plus photocopies of your documents.
detail.fil: I-download at i-print ang application form at e-receipt mula sa email, kasama ang mga photocopy ng dokumento.

detail.en: Arrive 30 minutes early for verification, encoding, and photo/fingerprints. Claim on the release date or wait for courier delivery.
detail.fil: Dumating nang 30 minutong mas maaga para sa beripikasyon, encoding, at biometrics. Kunin sa takdang petsa o hintayin ang delivery.

text.en: Printed confirmed DFA appointment & application form
text.fil: Naka-print na kumpirmadong DFA appointment at application form
Orihinal na PSA Birth Certificate + 1 photocopy

text.en: Original valid government-issued ID + 1 photocopy (front & back)
text.fil: Orihinal na balidong government ID + 1 photocopy (harap at likod)
Naka-print na e-receipt / katibayan ng bayad
Itim na bolpen

summary.en: Free foundational Philippine Identification System registration for first-time applicants.
summary.fil: Libreng pagpaparehistro para sa National ID (PhilSys) ng Pilipinas para sa mga unang beses na aplikante.

location.en: Nearest PhilSys Fixed Registration Center (often in malls, city/municipal halls, or PSA outlets).
location.fil: Pinakamalapit na PhilSys Registration Center (karaniwang nasa mall, munisipyo, o tanggapan ng PSA).

fee.en: Free (initial registration, ePhilID, and Digital National ID)
fee.fil: Libre (unang pagpaparehistro, ePhilID, at Digital National ID)

processingTime.en: ~15–30 mins on-site; Digital ID available once verified
processingTime.fil: ~15–30 minuto sa site; makukuha ang Digital ID kapag beripikado na

validity.en: Lifetime (periodic biometric updates per PhilSys rules)

notice.en: Source checked. Keep your Transaction Slip safe—you need the Transaction Reference Number (TRN) to access your Digital National ID.
notice.fil: Nasuri ang sanggunian. Ingatan ang iyong Transaction Slip—kailangan ang TRN upang makuha ang Digital National ID.

acceptedIds.en: Primary: Passport, UMID, Driver's License, or PRC ID (any 1)
acceptedIds.fil: Pangunahin: Pasaporte, UMID, Driver's License, o PRC ID (alinman sa 1)

acceptedIds.en: Secondary (if no primary ID): PSA Birth Certificate + Student ID, Barangay Clearance, Postal ID, or Voter's ID
acceptedIds.fil: Sekondarya (kung walang primary ID): PSA Birth Certificate + Student ID, Barangay Clearance, Postal ID, o Voter's ID

tips.en: Best first primary ID for students: it is completely free and accepted for PNP, NBI, DFA Passport, SSS, and bank accounts.
tips.fil: Pinakamainam na unang primary ID para sa mga estudyante: libre ito at tinatanggap sa PNP, NBI, DFA Passport, SSS, at mga bangko.

tips.en: Once verified, you can generate your official Digital National ID at national-id.gov.ph using your TRN even before the physical card arrives.
tips.fil: Kapag beripikado na, maaari mong kunin ang Digital National ID sa national-id.gov.ph gamit ang iyong TRN habang hinihintay ang pisikal na card.

detail.en: Check the official PhilSys website or your LGU/PSA page for active registration centers near you.
detail.fil: Tingnan sa opisyal na website ng PhilSys o pahina ng PSA/LGU ang mga bukas na registration center.

detail.en: Submit one primary ID, or your PSA Birth Certificate paired with a valid secondary ID such as your School ID.
detail.fil: Ipakita ang isang primary ID, o ang PSA Birth Certificate na may kasamang secondary ID tulad ng School ID.

detail.en: Review your encoded details carefully, complete iris/fingerprint/photo capture, and receive your Transaction Slip (TRN).
detail.fil: Suriin ang iyong detalye, magpakuha ng iris/fingerprint/larawan, at kunin ang Transaction Slip (TRN).

title.en: Access Digital National ID / claim card
title.fil: Kunin ang Digital National ID o card

detail.en: Use your TRN at national-id.gov.ph to view your Digital National ID or request an ePhilID while waiting for card delivery.
detail.fil: Gamitin ang TRN sa national-id.gov.ph upang makita ang Digital National ID o kumuha ng ePhilID habang hinihintay ang card.

text.en: Original supporting document (Primary ID or PSA Birth Certificate + Student/Secondary ID)
text.fil: Orihinal na dokumento (Primary ID o PSA Birth Certificate + Student/Secondary ID)

text.en: Active mobile number and email address for notifications
text.fil: Aktibong numero ng telepono at email para sa mga abiso

text.en: Folder or sleeve to keep your Transaction Slip (TRN) safe after capture
text.fil: Lalagyan o folder upang hindi mawala ang Transaction Slip (TRN)

summary.en: Online SS Number registration for first-time jobseekers and new members.
summary.fil: Online na pagkuha ng SS Number para sa mga naghahanap ng unang trabaho at bagong miyembro.

location.en: Apply online at member.sss.gov.ph; optional branch visit if submitting documents in person.
location.fil: Mag-apply online sa member.sss.gov.ph; pumunta lamang sa sangay ng SSS kung kailangang magpasa nang personal.

fee.en: Free registration (contributions begin once employed or paying voluntarily)
fee.fil: Libreng pagpaparehistro (magsisimula ang hulog kapag may trabaho o boluntaryo)

processingTime.en: Instant temporary SS Number via email; permanent tagging after document check
processingTime.fil: Agarang temporary SS Number sa email; magiging permanent pagkatapos ng beripikasyon

validity.en: Lifetime (only one SS Number per person)
validity.fil: Panghabambuhay (isang SS Number lamang bawat tao)

notice.en: Source checked. Never register a second SS Number—your single number stays with you for life.
notice.fil: Nasuri ang sanggunian. Huwag kailanman kumuha ng pangalawang SS Number—iisa lamang ito habambuhay.

acceptedIds.en: PSA Birth Certificate (primary proof of identity for SSS)
acceptedIds.fil: PSA Birth Certificate (pangunahing patunay sa SSS)

acceptedIds.en: Plus 1 valid ID if submitting at a branch: PhilSys / National ID, Passport, Driver's License, Postal ID, or UMID
acceptedIds.fil: Dagdag na 1 valid ID kung pupunta sa sangay: PhilSys / National ID, Pasaporte, Driver's License, Postal ID, o UMID

tips.en: Most employers already accept your printed SS Number Slip and E-1 Form (with Temporary status) for pre-employment onboarding.
tips.fil: Tinatanggap na ng karamihan sa mga employer ang naka-print na SS Number Slip at E-1 Form (kahit Temporary pa) para sa pagpasok sa trabaho.

tips.en: Upload or submit your PSA Birth Certificate early to convert your status from Temporary to Permanent so you can access future benefits and loans.
tips.fil: Magpasa nang maaga ng PSA Birth Certificate upang maging Permanent ang iyong status para sa mga benepisyo at loan.

detail.en: Open the Online SS Number Application at member.sss.gov.ph, enter your name, birthdate, and active email, and verify the link sent to you.
detail.fil: Buksan ang Online SS Number Application sa member.sss.gov.ph, ilagay ang detalye at email, at kumpirmahin ang link na ipapadala.

title.en: Download SS Number Slip & E-1 Form
title.fil: I-download ang SS Number Slip at E-1 Form

detail.en: Complete the remaining form fields and download/save PDF copies of your SS Number Slip and Personal Record (E-1 Form).
detail.fil: Kumpletuhin ang natitirang detalye at i-download ang PDF ng SS Number Slip at E-1 Form.

detail.en: Register on My.SSS using your new SS Number and check your email for the activation link.
detail.fil: Magrehistro sa My.SSS gamit ang bagong SS Number at buksan ang activation link sa iyong email.

title.en: Submit birth record for Permanent status
title.fil: Ipasa ang birth certificate para maging Permanent

detail.en: Upload a clear scan of your PSA Birth Certificate online (or present original + photocopy at an SSS branch) to tag your number as Permanent.
detail.fil: Mag-upload ng malinaw na kopya ng PSA Birth Certificate online (o dalhin sa sangay ng SSS) upang maging Permanent ang status.

place.en: My.SSS portal or nearest SSS branch
place.fil: My.SSS portal o pinakamalapit na sangay ng SSS

text.en: Active personal email address and mobile number
text.fil: Aktibong personal na email address at numero ng telepono

text.en: PSA Birth Certificate (clear scan for upload / original + photocopy for branch)
text.fil: PSA Birth Certificate (malinaw na scan para sa upload / orihinal + photocopy sa sangay)

text.en: One valid government-issued ID (if visiting a branch)
text.fil: Isang balidong government-issued ID (kung pupunta sa sangay)

text.en: Printed SS Number Slip and E-1 Form (for employer submission)
text.fil: Naka-print na SS Number Slip at E-1 Form (para sa employer)

summary.en: Get your 12-digit PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) and Member Data Record (MDR) for employment or coverage.
summary.fil: Pagkuha ng 12-digit PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) at Member Data Record (MDR) para sa trabaho o benepisyo.

location.en: Nearest PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO), such as Batangas City or Lipa LHIO.
location.fil: Pinakamalapit na PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO), tulad ng Batangas City o Lipa LHIO.

fee.en: Free registration (monthly premium applies once employed or self-paying)
fee.fil: Libreng pagpaparehistro (may buwanang hulog kapag may trabaho o nagbabayad)

processingTime.en: Usually same-day issuance of PIN and printed MDR at LHIO

reason.en: Ask the school or employer requesting your document for their exact checklist. Most students start with a free National ID, a PSA Birth Certificate, and NBI or PNP clearance.
reason.fil: Itanong sa paaralan o employer ang eksaktong listahan ng kailangan. Karaniwang inuuna ng mga estudyante ang libreng National ID, PSA Birth Certificate, at NBI o PNP clearance.

compare.en: Starter stack: 1) PSA Birth Certificate (needed by DFA, SSS, PhilHealth) → 2) National ID (free valid ID) → 3) NBI or PNP Clearance (when applying for work).
compare.fil: Karaniwang pagkakasunod-sunod: 1) PSA Birth Certificate (kailangan sa DFA, SSS, PhilHealth) → 2) National ID (libreng valid ID) → 3) NBI o PNP Clearance (kapag mag-aapply ng trabaho).

reason.en: PNP and NBI clearances are issued by different agencies. Confirm with your employer or school which one they accept before paying.
reason.fil: Magkaibang ahensya ang naglalabas ng PNP at NBI clearance. Kumpirmahin sa employer o paaralan kung alin ang tinatanggap bago magbayad.

compare.en:
PNP Clearance: ~₱150, needs 1 valid ID, 6-month validity, processed at local police stations.
NBI Clearance: ~₱130, needs 2 valid IDs, 1-year validity, commonly requested by corporate employers and abroad.
compare.fil:
PNP Clearance: ~₱150, 1 valid ID, 6 na buwang bisa, sa lokal na police station.
NBI Clearance: ~₱130, 2 valid ID, 1 taong bisa, madalas hingin ng malalaking kumpanya at para sa abroad.

reason.en: Consult PNP for renewal, authorized representative, or special cases. You can still review the standard guide below for general steps.
reason.fil: Kumonsulta sa PNP para sa renewal, kinatawan, o espesyal na kaso. Maaari mo pa ring tingnan ang gabay sa ibaba para sa karaniwang hakbang.

reason.en: Consult NBI for renewal, authorized representative, or special cases. You can still review the standard guide below for general steps.
reason.fil: Kumonsulta sa NBI para sa renewal, kinatawan, o espesyal na kaso. Maaari mo pa ring tingnan ang gabay sa ibaba para sa karaniwang hakbang.

reason.en: Almost all schools, passport applications, SSS, and employers require a PSA-issued Birth Certificate (SECPA), not a municipal Local Civil Registry copy.
reason.fil: Halos lahat ng paaralan, pasaporte, SSS, at trabaho ay PSA Birth Certificate (SECPA) ang hinihingi—hindi ang lokal na kopya mula sa munisipyo.

compare.en:
PSA Birth Certificate: Printed on yellow/blue SECPA security paper; accepted nationwide.
Local Civil Registry (LCR) copy: Certified copy from your birth municipality; mainly used if your PSA record is missing, blurred, or under correction.
compare.fil:
PSA Birth Certificate: Nakaimprenta sa SECPA security paper; tinatanggap saanman.
Lokal na LCR copy: Mula sa munisipyo kung saan ipinanganak; kailangan lamang kung kulang, malabo, o may pagwawasto sa PSA.

reason.en: The local-copy note covers only your own existing record registered in Taal. Ask the relevant municipal civil registrar—or request a PSA Birth Certificate if that is what you actually need.
reason.fil: Sarili mong umiiral na talang nakarehistro sa Taal lamang ang saklaw. Magtanong sa kaukulang civil registrar—o kumuha ng PSA Birth Certificate kung iyon ang talagang hinihingi.

reason.en: If you do not have any primary government ID yet, start with the free National ID (PhilSys) before applying for a Philippine Passport.
reason.fil: Kung wala ka pang primary government ID, unahin ang libreng National ID (PhilSys) bago mag-apply ng Pasaporte.

compare.en:
National ID (PhilSys): Free, accepts PSA Birth Certificate + Student ID.
Philippine Passport (DFA): ₱950+, 10-year validity, ideal once you have a PSA Birth Certificate and valid ID.
compare.fil:
National ID (PhilSys): Libre, tinatanggap ang PSA Birth Certificate + Student ID.
Pasaporte (DFA): ₱950+, 10 taong bisa, mainam kung may PSA Birth Certificate at valid ID na.

reason.en: Most Filipino employers ask for both an SSS Number and a PhilHealth PIN/MDR during pre-employment onboarding. Start with SSS online (instant) and prepare your PMRF for PhilHealth.
reason.fil: Karaniwang hinihingi ng mga employer ang parehong SSS Number at PhilHealth PIN/MDR bago pumasok sa trabaho. Unahin ang SSS online at ihanda ang PMRF para sa PhilHealth.

compare.en:
SSS Number: Applied 100% online at member.sss.gov.ph; gives instant SS Number Slip + E-1 Form.
PhilHealth: Fill out PMRF (2 copies) and submit at nearest PhilHealth LHIO for your 12-digit PIN and MDR.
compare.fil:
SSS Number: Online sa member.sss.gov.ph; agarang SS Number Slip at E-1 Form.
PhilHealth: Sagutan ang PMRF (2 kopya) at ipasa sa PhilHealth LHIO para sa 12-digit PIN at MDR.
